expected_description: A solid, clean rectangular block with straight vertical walls and a flat, well-defined top surface, surrounded by a thin brim at the base.
observed_description: An orange rectangular block is visible on the build plate. The top of the block is messy and uneven, with loose, un-adhered loops of orange filament (spaghetti) resting on top of the print and trailing off to the right side of the build plate.

comparison.expected: A flat, solid, and clean top layer of the rectangular block.
comparison.observed: Loose, chaotic loops of extruded filament on top of the block and trailing off to the right.
comparison.difference: Extruded filament is not adhering to the layer, resulting in loose spaghetti strands.

reason: The webcam image clearly shows loose, un-adhered loops of filament (spaghetti) on top of the printed block and trailing off to the right, which is not present in the clean G-code render.
